versions.changelog: Links to ytapi.dev pages carry utm_source=skill.

- Initial release of ytapi-youtube-transcript skill.
- Retrieve YouTube video transcripts, subtitles, or captions in multiple formats (plain text, Markdown, timestamped JSON, SRT, VTT).
- Supports multiple languages and formats; get transcripts even if other methods fail due to HTTP 429 or IP blocks.
- Requires a YTAPI API key; free accounts available with 200 credits and no credit card needed.
- Errors do not consume credits; daily and per-second limits apply until a credit pack is purchased.
